alt: 幾個孩子急著搭起野餐帳篷，有的拉布、有的拿桿，方向不一致，帳篷和繩子反而纏在一起。
scene_prompt: 七手八腳 means many people moving in a confused uncoordinated way. FIVE modern older children at a peaceful grassy picnic site all try to pitch the SAME small play tent at once, but without coordination: two pull opposite corners of sagging pale-blue tent cloth in incompatible directions, another holds a tent pole the wrong way, another tries to untangle loose rope, and the fifth gestures in confusion. The tent remains obviously half collapsed and wrinkled. All are standing safely, expressive puzzled faces; no injury or choking, no rope around a body. Show natural anatomy, normal hand count for each person. Emphasize confused group actions, NOT successful orderly teamwork.
